verdict.rationale: Lithic well-documents issuing least-privilege financial credentials for agents — virtual cards constrained by Authorization Rules (merchant category, velocity, spend limits) at program/account/card level, explicitly framed for agentic workflows (create a card for a test agent, configure rules, run transactions). However, this is scoping of payment instruments, not scoping of the underlying API key/credential itself — the MCP integration explicitly requires a single full-privilege Lithic API key with no documented key-level permission/scope system (e.g., read-only vs write, resource-restricted keys). Missing for 10: documented API-key-level scopes/roles/least-privilege credential issuance (not just card-level spend controls), and independent verification that agents can be restricted to a subset of API capabilities.
